config.graph_source: catalog-ann-v1, original immutable per-locale HNSW files and ID maps
config.fixed: original M=16, efConstruction=100, construction seed/order, float32 vectors, model, locale routing, cutoff=100, library/lock, single search thread, 16 warmup queries and 3 timed passes
config.worker_contract: use the verified original build contract for unchanged index/query workers; this separate experiment authorizes the additional depth without editing the old grid or its source files
config.metrics: strict top-100 agreement with saved matched Faiss Flat, known-Exact Recall@100, judgment coverage@10 and fixed c=60 RRF impact versus matched Flat and depth 512
config.nomination: unchanged: overall agreement >=0.95, each locale >=0.90; hybrid recall paired lower delta bound >=-0.005 overall and mean delta >=-0.005 in each locale versus matched Flat hybrid
config.timing: fresh per-locale workers for both 512 and 1024 with original shuffled query orders, warmup/passes/thread limits; first run 512 then 1024 per locale, replay reverse worker order; native retrieval/tie-sort timings exclude encoding/API/concurrency/output I/O
config.exact_control: reuse checksummed matched Flat rankings/metrics; its old timing is historical, not a newly measured speed comparator
config.repeat: fresh-process replay on identical graphs, all 3 passes within workers and both runs must reproduce rankings/metrics/selection; timing/order/RSS observations may differ
config.stop: one new search-depth point only; if any quality budget fails, nominate none and retain exact RRF; do not add another point or relax budgets inside this experiment
config.scope: validation development only; no graph build, encoding, training, quantization, new labels, serving or official test access

limits: One additional validation search-depth point chosen after a published miss diagnosis; prior grid/decision preserved. Same frozen graphs, new native query timings. Saved matched Flat timing is historical and not remeasured. Agreement is not human recall; unknown judgments stay unknown. Warm singleton timings exclude encoding/API/concurrency; RSS is one-locale worker memory. Nomination is not final-test or production adoption.
